name: lib-monorepo
title: TypeScript library monorepo (multi-package + changesets)
description: A multi-package TypeScript library workspace driven by pnpm + changesets. Two starter packages (core, utils) — each gets its own bundler config (tsup default; rslib / rollup also supported via --features). Output formats are multi-select per the format-* axis. Ships Biome + husky + commitlint + lint-staged at the workspace root.
